First paragraph treats the case of a K-automorphism group G, its actions on fundamental groupoids, and the combined action with Γ. It observes that Γ acts trivially on K-rational vertices while G need not. Second paragraph says the Γ-action is determined by its action on the base group and the right torsors of paths from x₀. Actual targeted mathematical check, refined statement 142-085-R1: for a connected groupoid C with fixed object set I containing x₀ and a group Γ fixing the objects, its action is uniquely determined by the Γ-action on G₀=Aut_C(x₀) together with compatible semilinear right G₀-torsor actions on every T_i=Hom_C(x₀,x_i), where T_{x₀}=G₀ carries that same automorphism action. Every Hom_C(x_i,x_j) is represented by (a,b)∈T_j×T_i modulo simultaneous right G₀ multiplication, via a b^{-1}. Applying γ to both entries is independent of representative because γ(ag)=γ(a)γ(g); it preserves composition and recovers the action. This proves the refined determination claim.

The connectedness/nonempty-torsor and compatibility assumptions in that check are stated explicitly; they were not inferred as supplied hypotheses from this isolated page. The geometric functorial action of K-automorphisms, commutation with Γ, and the topological/profinite identifications were transcribed and were not independently re-proved here.
